author: nicolas
summary: Liraasa 3.5, "Essentials, archetypes and optional domain packs" (ADR-0025), from the author's 3.5 patch, every module installed. PROPOSED: PROPOSED: ratify tier 1 first; tier 2 may be ratified, deferred or dropped item by item. Additions only, no new roots: rulings 3.5:G150-G151; 164 compounds, 20 listed derivations, 11 lexicalised diminutives, 2 restored forms and 150 English aliases, each entry noted with its tier and module. No 3.4 word, spelling or ruling changes.

rulings.ruling: A numeral joined by a hyphen to gaki (angle) names a polygon: tressa-gaki triangle, cuara-gaki square or quadrilateral, penta-gaki pentagon. rinba (ring) is the circle and vemisovla (sphere) the ball shape. The -san adjective follows: cuara-gakisan, square-shaped.

Foreign dishes, products and fixed proper concepts with no Liraasa equivalent are copied like names (2.0:G45), respelled in Liraasa letters, lower-case as common nouns, and given -san for adjectives: pitsa (pizza), hamburga (hamburger). Prefer a native compound whenever one is transparent.
